Brunson is the one healthy constant for New York with OG Anunoby and Jordan Clarkson out and Towns, Josh Hart and Miles McBride all questionable. He played 36 minutes on November 21, the last game Towns missed.

Jerome has started both games since returning from a hip injury and played 29 minutes on Monday with Cameron Boozer out. Boozer, Jerami Grant, Scotty Pippen Jr. and GG Jackson are all out again tonight, so the Memphis offense still leans on him.
